report_path_behavior_boundary: generated public conformance reports are provenance-only and cannot establish positive parser, sema, lowering, IR, runtime, e2e, capability, claim-ready, or compatibility support
artifact_path_behavior_boundary: tmp public conformance artifacts are provenance-only and cannot promote report-only, generated-only, dashboard-only, scorecard-only, badge-only, provisional, blocked, quarantined, fallback, shim, old-mode, workflow-label-only, or compatibility evidence to claim-ready support

behavior_boundary.primary_axis: behavior owner before workflow action, child report, tmp artifact, scorecard, badge, public summary, public status, or public claim language
behavior_boundary.support_authority: public conformance workflow rows are routing/provenance until e2e owner assignment is backed by upstream parser, sema, lowering, IR, and runtime evidence owners
behavior_boundary.retired_surface_rule: workflow-label-only success, report-only readiness, generated-summary-only readiness, tmp-artifact-only readiness, scorecard-only readiness, badge-only readiness, provisional-as-claim-ready, blocked/quarantined promotion, fallback workflows, shim workflows, old-mode commands, and compatibility workflows are provenance, canonical rejection, strict-error, or absent-support evidence

capability_truth_language.claim-ready: all required upstream evidence owners passed and no hard blocks remain
capability_truth_language.provisional: public summary is publishable with explicit caution and deductions
capability_truth_language.blocked: public summary is not claim-ready and must state the blocking evidence
